Parses intent, identifies target accounts, applies temporal filters & selectively activates detection engines
Calculates calibrated composite Risk Score = w₁·Rules + w₂·ZScore + w₃·ML_Prob + w₄·Graph_Risk (0–100 Scale)
Production Analyst Workspace (Streamlit Web Dashboard — app.py)

svg.text: Fig. 1. Architecture of AML Sentinel: Multi-Layer Agentic Financial Crime Intelligence & Transaction Monitoring Platform.
Combines Natural Language Intent Routing, 4-Tier Hybrid Detection (Rules, Z-Scores, RandomForest ML, Graph Motifs), TreeSHAP Explainability, and Automated FinCEN Form 111 SAR Generation.
Evaluated on 8,453 Transactions · 85.23% Recall · 85.75% Precision · ~88% False Positive Elimination · 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation
